brief: CASCO district, ~180 x 220 m, authored from the measured Potes historic core (box A, owner 2026-09-28) as the soul of the casco, not a 1:1 trace: the main spine along a plaza that opens onto a small channelled river, a short stretch of casco on the other bank reached by a stone bridge and a footbridge, a calle alta parallel to the spine on the hillside, 2-3 transversals, the Solana terrace up to a mirador, huertas and casonas on the upper edge. The river continues north towards the port district (downstream); the town rises from the port to the casco. Owner rules: 70 % comfortable / 20 % perceptible / 10 % strong-or-stairs, stairs as accent, 2-3 breathing spaces, legible landmarks. Fictional town: no Potes names, signs or landmarks. Street ids are our own.
